blurb: A recreational boating haven located on Lake Ray Hubbard fosters a fun, modern atmosphere where boaters can connect, relax, boat, dine, and unwind. With an exciting calendar of events, this expansive marina community offers excitement for every member of the family. From 60ft multi million dollar yachts to center-console fishing rigs, tritons and the latest in wakeboard - they all call Sapphire Bay Marina
